name: Awakened Shark-Eating Crab
body:
AWAKENED SHARK-EATING CRAB
CR 9

XP 6,400
Awakened shark-eating crab
N Huge vermin (aquatic)
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 10, flat-footed 18 (+2 Dex, –2 size, +10 natural)
hp 104 (10d8+60)
Fort +15, Ref +5, Will +6

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., swim 60 ft.
Melee 2 claw +15 (2d6+9 plus grab)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks constrict, darting claw, grab

STATISTICS

Str 29, Dex 14, Con 22, Int 8, Wis 12, Cha 4
Base Atk +7; CMB +18 (+22 grapple); CMD 30 (38 vs. trip)
Feats Great Fortitude, Improved Natural Attack, Iron Will, Power Attack, Weapon Focus (claw)
Skills Perception +5, Stealth –6, Swim +17
Languages Aquan
SQ water dependency

ABOUT

The crab is insanely greedy and has amassed a small fortune, which it stashes under the rocks in its cave.
